issues.problem: MVAD halves beta on essentially every densify step (faithful to the official code), so garden grows ~2.2x the no-MVAD population by 1.5k steps and ~4x the gsplat baseline by 2k. Final garden baseline is 4.55M, so the MVGS run may reach 10-18M and could hit the 20M cap (the run then aborts) or run out of GPU memory with 3 views sharing one autograd graph.
issues.evidence: GPU ablation (garden, mvgs-outdoor, stages [[3,-1,1500]]): full 1.72M (halved 10/10 densify steps), nocrd 1.72M, nomvad 0.79M, none 0.79M; gsplat baseline 0.65M at step 1500.
issues.fix: Keep --max-gaussians at >=20M (or higher) for the outdoor scenes, request GPUs with >=40 GB free, and record the Gaussian count in the report as a contradiction of paper Table 2 (0.8M vs 1.1M).

issues.problem: In the official code, iteration == opt.iterations at the end of each 3000-iteration stage skips optimizer.step() (train.py:187) before the checkpoint. The runtime always applies Adam before density control, so the port applies one extra Adam update per coarse stage (3 in total).
issues.fix: Add it to the fidelity-gap list (it is negligible).

issues.problem: One ratio (counter 3115/1600) is used for every indoor scene. Room is 3114x2075, so the -r 4/2 sizes come out 1 px wider than the official round(W_full/r) (779 vs 778, 1558 vs 1557).
issues.fix: Set a per-scene ratio or derive it from the source images; otherwise just document it (already partly covered by gap 3).

issues.problem: The view-stack RNG uses config seed 0 whatever ss-train --seed is, so different seeds share the same view order.
issues.fix: Optionally mix in the --seed argv value. This does not matter for single-seed benchmarks.

issues.problem: The CUDA CRD probe uses two views that share the same box, so the official box-index quirk (box_index official vs paper) is never told apart by a probe. Only the unit tests cover it, if at all.
issues.fix: Add a 3-view case where sorted boxes differ and check that the official/paper cuboids differ in the expected way.

issues.problem: With M=3 on garden, CRD cuboids contain 0-9 Gaussians per densify step (13 in total over 10 steps). The mechanism is a near no-op outdoors (faithful port: the AABB of 4 closest-point midpoints of a 20x40 window is tiny). Do not credit outdoor gains to CRD.
issues.evidence: ablation history: full inbox_total 13 vs cloned 1.31M; nocrd population identical within 0.4%
issues.fix: Mention it in the report; indoor M=48 (1128 pairs/step) may differ.

probe_assessment.why: Compares against independently rendered per-view losses and gradients, and rejects a mean or a single view.
Checks stage boundaries, M per stage, official sizes, the hand-scaled-K render and that eval renders at full resolution.
An independent arccos form; [0,70] must halve and [0,50] must not.
Brute-force window port, independent unprojection and midpoint; an in-box clone is required and crd=False must clone nothing. It does not tell the box-index variants apart (minor).
Checks last-view-only counts, the stage size switch and that the LR restart overrides the runtime schedule.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: gsplat vs Inria rasterizer (shared with the baseline)
Runtime Adam step before density control, plus one extra Adam step at the end of each coarse stage
Coarse targets are bicubic-antialiased from the w1600 images, not PIL resizes from full-res; one full_width_ratio for every indoor scene (±1 px on room)
One continuous run instead of a checkpoint chain; the carried state is equivalent

Paper Table 2 claims fewer Gaussians than 3DGS; the official code (and this port) produces many more because MVAD fires on almost every densify step: P(halve) for 3 random garden views from the COLMAP origin is 0.92, and 1.0 for M>=8
summary: Faithful port. The multi-view batch reloads only the train split (cameras checked against the runtime by K and viewmat), so no test images leak into training. Evaluation runs under no_grad at full resolution. Densification stats use only the last view's means2d gradient, scaled to NDC by stage W/2, H/2, as in the official code. Stage table, per-stage densify/reset/LR restart and step totals (39000 indoor, 30000 outdoor) match run_360.py/train.py. MVAD check (the key question): the native w1600 frames are in the COLMAP world frame (c2w translations equal -R^T t from sparse/0 for garden/counter/room, and the loader does no recentring). The official code uses the same un-normalised camera_center / ||camera_center|| with the strict > 1 test at every densify step, so the port is identical. The extra Gaussian growth comes from the official MVAD rule: a GPU ablation shows MVAD alone accounts for it (1.72M vs 0.79M at 1.5k steps) and CRD adds about 0. This is a paper-vs-code contradiction, not a port bug. No critical or major issues; the main risk is the outdoor Gaussian budget and memory.
